name: Treacherous Cold
objectiveText: Collect the rifles of fallen mountaineers. Stoneanvil's Rifle  ( 1 ) Sunhammer's Rifle  ( 1 ) Coalbeard's Rifle  ( 1 )

comments.body:
These guns are next to fallen dwarven mountaineers.

[url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/maps?data=1:520440600500530590]Here's[/url] a map to all 3.
cant loot at least sunhammer rifle. says "no loot"
replies: Still bugged despite today's hotfix that was supposed to solve such issues.

comments.body:
I was not able to loot Sunhammer's rifle, getting an error that said "There is no loot"
/reload did not fix the issue

Solved this instead by turning off Auto-Loot (no clue if necessary) then logging out, and then back in.
replies: This did not work for me. Still bugged

comments.body:
Coldbeard - follow the frozen river west of the quest giver. Dwarf is under the tree that has fallen across the river

Sunhammer - southeast of the quest giver. Dwarf lies next to a cart on the small path up to Vagash's cave

Stoneanvil - almost straight south of the quest giver in a valley. Dwarf lies next to a cart out in the open.
replies: Stoneanvil's location is more south-southwest of the quest giver. Go south to the valley that heads west, then look for the mentioned cart next to a tree on the south side of the valley to the west.

comments.body:
Bugged. Tried all tricks mentioned above, cleared cache, logged off, /reload.. nothing worked.
Can't pick any gun. Tried all 3 in case there is a specific order, nada.
I too am getting the "There is no loot." message when I try and loot Mountaineer Stoneanvil's rifle. I had no problem looting Sunhammer's and Coalbeard's rifles.
I had a problem with Coalbeard's Rifle, and as of Oct 9, 2026, I was able to loot it successfully!
